title: Toggle & Delete
description:
## Step 2: Toggle & Delete

Now make todos interactive. Each `<li>` needs:

### Requirements
1. A checkbox with class **`"toggle"`** that flips a `done` flag on the todo
2. When done, the `<li>` should have class **`"done"`** (you can style it later)
3. A delete button with class **`"delete"`** and text "×" that removes that todo
4. Keep the existing add behavior working
